spanish: Y daré favor de este pueblo en los ojos de Egipto, y será que andarán, no andarán vacíos.
grammarChanges: Added the required definite article: 'en ojos de Egipto' -> 'en los ojos de Egipto'.
readerNote: 'Vacíos' is kept as a predicate adjective agreeing with the implied plural subject (ustedes), rendering the adverb רֵיקָם as grammatical smoothing without changing its sense.
